notes.subject: כנעתך
notes.rationale: כנעה 'bundle/package' appears only here in the Tanakh.

notes.subject: כנעתך
notes.rationale: Some read 'thy shame' (כנעה as from כנע), most read 'thy bundle of goods'.

notes.subject: yu meri
notes.rationale: Feminine singular address — Zion/Jerusalem personified as a woman under siege.

notes.subject: baksit
notes.rationale: כנעתך is literally 'thy package/bundle of belongings'.

translation: Kisim baksit bilong yu i kamap olgeta long graun, yu meri we yu stap insait long banis bilong pait.
